records.other_tensors: Source/native tensor types; not an overall 2.0 bpw average.
records.evidence_type: Publisher declaration at the recipe-pinned artifact revision; not a new tensor payload audit.
records.scope: Quantization identity only. Upstream model-card benchmark results are not measurements from this collection.

records.evidence_type: Retained tensor payload/parameter audit, cross-checked against the installed safetensors file sizes and header lengths; no inference.
records.formula: 8 * stored weight bytes / full logical parameter count for the same tensor scope

main_weights.scope: All retained main checkpoint tensors, including vision, excluding the native MTP head; includes scales and other quantization payload.

complete_checkpoint.scope: Main tensors plus the native MTP head.

records.scope: Weight storage calculation, not active MoE parameter count, GPU runtime memory, KV cache size or an inference measurement.
